title: Decide whether feed events carry a run-incarnation id
description:
Found by tick 55i (run epic-9pd, attempt 2), routed as a contract change to pengelbrecht/ticks. 55i fixed replayed terminal events with a from-now cursor, which is right for subscribers that join live. A subscriber that wants history AND correct terminal attribution — a long-lived dashboard following one run from offset zero across a resume — cannot tell one incarnation's run_finished from another's without re-deriving incarnations from resumed/stage orderings. The fix would be a field on ticfac.run_event.v1, which is closed (additionalProperties: false) and pinned in the contract bundle, so it is a versioned upstream change, not an edit.

This is the operator's dashboard feed idea (backlog tick n0r) meeting a real constraint. Decide it when the dashboard is designed, not before: if no consumer follows from zero, the cursor is enough and the schema stays as is.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded decision: either the run event schema gains a versioned incarnation field upstream with ticfac emitting it, or the decision not to is recorded with the consumer that would have needed it
